data.title: General Knowledge Trivia
data.description: A fun mix of trivia questions spanning science, culture, sports, geography, and more. How broad is your general knowledge? Challenge yourself and find out!

data.title: Geography Challenge
data.description: Test your knowledge of world geography including continents, countries, capitals, rivers, mountain ranges, and physical features of our planet.

data.title: World History Essentials
data.description: Journey through pivotal moments in world history from ancient civilizations to the modern era. Test your knowledge of empires, revolutions, and the events that shaped our world.

data.title: Python Data Structures
data.description: Explore Python's built-in data structures including lists, tuples, dictionaries, sets, and their methods. Covers comprehensions, performance characteristics, and common patterns.

data.title: Biology Essentials
data.description: From DNA to ecosystems, explore fundamental biology concepts including cell biology, genetics, evolution, and ecology. Perfect for students and lifelong learners.
